notes: CDER letter combining (1) a records review under section 704(a)(4) (no on-site inspection) finding CGMP failures for OTC drug manufacturing -- no finished-product assay testing, no process/cleaning validation, inadequate high-risk-component identity testing, no stability program -- and (2) a website-labeling review finding the 'syNeo' antiperspirant line (7 named products) to be unapproved new drugs/misbranded because their active-ingredient combination does not conform to the OTC antiperspirant monograph (M019). Classified letter_type as cgmp_nonsterile since the CGMP findings are the more extensive/substantive charge, but violation_categories includes the unapproved_new_drug and misbranding charges from the marketing section as well. location_contains is null because no facility inspection occurred (records review only, consistent with other 704(a)(4) letters in this corpus).
